from pathlib import Path
p=Path('src/camera/CameraController.ts')
s=p.read_text()
needle='this.modeValue=mode;'
if needle not in s:
    raise SystemExit('mode assignment pattern not found')
if "this.pitch=this.profile[mode].pitch;" not in s:
    s=s.replace(needle, needle+"if(mode!=='free')this.pitch=this.profile[mode].pitch;", 1)
old="resolveCameraPosition(target,desired,this.collision,{minDistance:p.minDistance})"
if old not in s:
    raise SystemExit('collision pattern not found')
s=s.replace(old,"resolveCameraPosition(target,desired,this.collision)",1)
p.write_text(s)
PY
echo '--- camera tests ---'
npx vitest run src/camera
echo '--- typecheck ---'
npx tsc -b --pretty false
echo '--- build ---'
npm run build","timeoutSeconds":1200}

Изменённые файлы: src/camera/CameraController.ts плюс ранее созданные CameraController.test.ts и экспорт в src/camera/index.ts.
